title: Hell place
body:
How can you allow this when all the plans and meetings marked in this "wonderful" calendar are deleted? One moment I see everything, the next moment it's all gone! And I'm not the only one this has happened to! I wouldn't be writing this if I had an iPhone 6, I would understand that it's time for an upgrade and that the app is glitching. My phone is probably the latest model, and this calendar deletion problem is not the first time it has happened. People, do something!
A top-level company can't manage a calendar app, shame on them...
author: domcele

title: Calendar doesn’t sync with Reminders
body: Shame it can’t sync the Reminders app with Calendar app. From the start these two apps had to work together and now apparently it’s only starting from iOS 18 this trick does work…not very convenient when using both iPhone and MacBook Pro…
